discovery_source: exact Phase B activation Git commit tree
discovery_algorithm: enumerate every Git-tracked file matching tracked_path_patterns at the exact activation tree
reject a missing tracked file or an untracked file below a protected pattern
sort paths by raw UTF-8 byte order
compute SHA-256 of each actual working-tree file before Tier 2
repeat enumeration and SHA-256 after Tier 2
require identical ordered path and digest lists
require git diff and git status firewalls to show no protected or rehearsal artifact staged
proof_output: ordered before/after path-digest manifests plus constructor-handle audit
